Listed on the Government of India's Advantage Healthcare directory of India-facing specialist consultants, i.e. presented internationally as a medical-value-travel destination consultant. Prior senior post: consultant in Cardiac Sciences at CARE Hospitals, Hi-Tech City, before AIG - a multi-institution senior career.

notes:
NAME-FORM NOTE: he is indexed under several forms of the same name - 'Dr. Swaroop Bharadi', 'Dr. Swaroop G Bharadi', 'Dr. Bharadi Govind Swaroop', 'Dr. Bharadi Swaroop Govind' and (as a Practo title typo) 'Dr. Swaroop G Bhardi'. All resolve to Interventional Cardiology at AIG Hospitals Gachibowli, Hyderabad, with identical qualifications (MBBS Shivaji University Kolhapur 1997; DNB General Medicine 2003; DNB Cardiology 2009), so they are one person, not several.

Identity verified on four criteria - name + specialty (Interventional Cardiology) + hospital (AIG Hospitals) + city (Hyderabad/Gachibowli) - agreeing across TWO INDEPENDENT OFFICIAL sources: (1) healinindia.gov.in, the Government of India's Advantage Healthcare directory, with a page titled 'Dr. Swaroop G Bharadi - Cardiology in AIG Hospitals'; and (2) AIG Hospitals itself, through its own official Facebook channel, whose video is titled 'At AIG Hospitals, our team of Interventional Cardiologists led by Dr Swaroop Bhar...'. These are two genuinely independent publishers (a .gov.in registry and the employing hospital), which is what the High band requires. Practo and Credihealth agree on every fact but are corroborating only and were NOT counted toward the band.

BAND CAVEAT FOR THE HUMAN REVIEWER: the AIG-side evidence is AIG's own official social channel rather than an aighospitals.com web page, because AIG's per-doctor page for him is DEAD. The legacy plural-family URL https://aighospitals.com/doctors/dr-swaroop-g-bharadi was returned by search but carries the title '404 Page Not Found', so per the rules it was NOT recorded and hospital_profile is deliberately left BLANK. Two further targeted allowed_domains=aighospitals.com searches (on 'Swaroop Bharadi' + interventional cardiologist/cath lab, and on the 'Dr. Swaroop G Bharadi' variant) surfaced NO live AIG per-doctor page under any of the four AIG URL families. No URL was constructed to fill the gap.

NO email or phone recorded. A ZoomInfo result appeared prominently in results advertising an 'Email: ****@aighospitals.com & Phone Number' for him and asserting the title 'Interventional Cardiologist, Co Director Cath Lab AIG Hospitals'. ZoomInfo is a barred contact-broker/scraped database, the address is MASKED, and completing a masked address is explicitly forbidden - so NOTHING from that record was used: not the email, not the phone, and not the 'Co-Director, Cath Lab' title, which is therefore NOT asserted anywhere in this file despite appearing credible. If a human wants that title it must be re-sourced from a legitimate published page. No published personal email or mobile for him surfaced on any indexed page. No LinkedIn profile surfaced and none was guessed.

The Facebook item is AIG's institutional page, not a personal account of his, so it is recorded under other_profiles rather than the facebook field, consistent with the treatment of his AIG colleagues.

owns_clinic false: senior consultant and publicly described team lead within AIG, but no personally owned clinic, practice entity, second location or personal website was found in public search.
